location.ref: Spiritual Gems, on the initiate's remaining births

paraphrase: One who has been initiated by a true Master will not be reborn below the human form and, at most within four lives, will reach the true home, even if he practises little; practice shortens the way.
speaker: Sawan Singh
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only. Widely reported Beas teaching; its locus in Spiritual Gems is not recalled (low).

location.ref: Spiritual Gems, on the three kinds of karma

paraphrase: Karma is of three kinds: the destiny (pralabdh) that made this body, which must be lived out; the stored (sinchit) karma, which the Master burns at initiation or through the disciple's meditation; and the new (kriyaman) karma made now, which the disciple should avoid by living by the vows and doing all as the Master's service.
speaker: Sawan Singh
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
